newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - ADM hold repeated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ADM hold repeated.

text.p: Dain Bosworth analyst Bonnie Wittenburg said Tuesday she reiterated her hold rating on Archer Daniels Midland Co.

-- "The six- to 12-month outlook for earnings is not clear enough for us at this time to get more excited about this stock," Wittenburg said in a report. "We've generally assumed sizable crops, which could help ADM's grain costs. However, capacity expansion and exports play a huge role."
-- Shares of the grain processing and agribusiness giant were up 1/4 at 21-1/8.

-- She said ADM has made several alliances or acquisitions over the past few months, which she considers positive. ADM also has announced various plant expansions over the past few months, she added, "that show continued commitment to high-growth, high-margin areas, particularly bioproducts."
-- Concerns remain about pressure on near-term earnings for high fructose corn syrup and soybeans.
-- Litigation issues remain for ADM, which last year pleaded guilty to two counts of price fixing, she said. She added that she considers many of these issues are behind the company.
